entry.title: Revisiting Avatar-As-Image: High-Fidelity Registration is All You Need
entry.summary: The representation of 3D clothed humans as standardized 2D UV texture and displacement maps over an underlying body model has long been studied. This compact representation is enticing as it enables pretrained image networks to process, generate, and edit 3D avatars, but is only useful if scans are accurately aligned and brought into correspondence via high-fidelity registration. entry.title: Single-Stream Multi-Feature Fusion with Temporal Robustness for Gait Emotion Recognition
entry.summary: 3D skeleton-based gait emotion recognition faces high annotation costs, data scarcity, and poor generalization on heterogeneous data. entry.title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
entry.summary: We present Vidu S2, which comprises Vidu S2-Avatar, a real-time interactive digital-character model, and Vidu S2-Editing, a real-time video editing model. Moreover, we explore the feasibility of real-time spatial video generation for both Vidu S2-Avatar and Vidu S2-Editing.
